trust_decision.summary: The CSS3 recursive-descent parser decides how deep attacker-supplied stylesheet nesting may go before it refuses; the shared guard is Css3::recurse (MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH = 64), and at the pinned commit the block, function, calc and pseudo-function cycles already go through it.

landing_point.why: A summary about uncontrolled recursion and stack exhaustion leads an engineer to the CSS parser's nested block cycle (@media{ repeated), which is also what the README's recursion-guard note and the block.rs tests describe.

fix_sites.entry_point: Css3::parse_str / Css3::parse_stream (public API; reached by page stylesheets, inline style attributes via crates/gosub_css3/src/system.rs:114, and the DOM-JS style setter at crates/gosub_domjs/src/style.rs:64)
Css3::parse_str -> declaration value -> calc() nested function
Css3::parse_str -> declaration value -> calc() parenthesised group

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All guarded cycles sit in one crate (gosub_css3/src/parser) behind one helper; the separately bounded @supports raw scanner (crates/gosub_css3/src/supports.rs:18-20, :307) and @import chain (crates/gosub_css3/src/imports.rs:15-17, :55) use their own caps and are not fix sites as far as can be seen.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: parse_condition only recurses on an error-recovery branch of the media/container feature parser and returns a flat node, so a solver can argue it is not a nesting cycle like blocks or functions and leave it alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With ignore_errors the depth error is absorbed per level, so over-deep input is truncated at the cap rather than rejected, and inputs up to 63 nested @media levels must still parse whole; a fix that makes the depth error fatal, or a cap that is too low, breaks the recovering parse and real-world nesting.

O6_input_shapes: nested calc() functions and bare parenthesised groups inside calc()
mixed cycles summing into one shared depth counter (lib.rs:75-77)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Media/container condition parsing calls itself on its feature-parse error branch (condition.rs:42-46) without going through Css3::recurse, so each repeated malformed parenthesised term may add a stack frame.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an error-recovery path in a prelude parser, not a nesting construct, and its result is flat, so it looks unrelated to the block/function/selector cycles the guard documents.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same crate, different file (parser/condition.rs, reached from parser/at_rule/media.rs:245,262 and parser/at_rule/container.rs:25)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A recursive container-query condition parser for and/or/not groups that recurses directly instead of via self.recurse.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Container queries are listed in the README as unsupported, so a maintainer adding them would plausibly write a direct recursive-descent parser next to the existing unguarded parse_condition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AST-to-condition conversion that recurses over nested Condition nodes to evaluate not/and/or.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The evaluator already converts the AST in from_ast/term_from_ast; supporting nested media conditions would naturally recurse over the node tree.

O9_family: CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion in a recursive-descent CSS parser (stack exhaustion)
